from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = [(y - top, x - left) for y, x in cells]
            height = max(y for y, x in shape) + 1
            width = max(x for y, x in shape) + 1
            objects.append((left, top, color, shape, height, width))
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: (obj[0], obj[1]))
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    row = col = 0
    for _, _, color, shape, height, width in objects:
        for dy, dx in shape:
            y, x = row + dy, col + dx
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = color
        row += height - 1
        col += width - 1
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-151a42b7.py'
p.write_text(program)
print(p)
